Paste the SAP report

In the SAP report, press Ctrl+A then Ctrl+C. Then just press Ctrl+V - the board loads automatically. No headers needed.

Run the Order Report

  1. In SAP, run the Open Orders report.
  2. Click in the report, press Ctrl+A, then Ctrl+C.
  3. Come back here and press Ctrl+V - pick status loads automatically.

Settings

Off returns to colouring every lane by dwell time with a green dot for completed.
What each file gave the board on the last read. Written tells you whether the puller is still writing; Read gave tells you whether the board understood it.
Days are 1 to 5 for Monday to Friday, 6 Saturday, 0 Sunday. An end earlier than the start runs past midnight.
Needs read and write access to the folder. On a read-only viewer the marker turns gold instead and the button downloads it.
Window is measured back from the newest confirmation in the file, so it lands on real activity when running from a saved export.
Leave blank to follow the clock. Set it to run the board from a saved set of exports: every today-scoped figure reads against this date instead. A banner shows while it is on.
For logs written before the monitoring-gap guard existed. Removes runs of totes all stamped as clearing in the same minute with a dwell of days, and flags any remaining long dwell so it stays out of the throughput figures.
Longest matching prefix wins, so D500 stays static rack inside the D100 to D700 range. Leave blank to restore the defaults.

Settings

Turn on Move Mode, then close this panel and drag any outlined section (each lane group, Hospital, the legend, Last Refresh, the cogs, and the buttons) to reposition it. Drag the blue square at a section's bottom-right corner to stretch or shrink it: drag sideways for width, down for height, or diagonally for both. Positions and sizes are saved automatically.
Data arrives from the host service the moment a new export lands. The interval below is only a safety net for when the live connection drops.
Turn off if you sometimes load staging alone and don't want the pick-status prompt.
The Staging Lane Health service on the host PC reads the SAP exports and shares them with every screen. The report folder, file names and the SAP pull are managed on the Admin page.

How to use this board

Generate the report manually (until the puller is running)

Run this in SAP to make a fresh report the board can read, then repeat the export every 15 minutes or so to keep the board current.

1. Open the Warehouse Monitor

Open the Warehouse Management Monitor. Enter Warehouse Number 0103 and Monitor zarden, then click Check. In the tree on the left, open Stock and Bin, then Storage Bin, then double-click Handling Unit.

2. Pick the bins and run it

On the selection screen, open the Multiple Selection arrow next to Storage Bin. Type one per line: e* , f* , I* , D8* , TOTE* . Then click Execute (the clock icon).

3. Export to a spreadsheet

Right-click anywhere in the report and choose Spreadsheet. Pick Select from All Available Formats, choose Excel - Office Open XML Format (XLSX), check Always Use Selected Format, then click the green check.

4. Save it where the board looks

Save into the C:\report folder and name the file HU STAGING. This is the same folder the board watches, so it will pick the file up on its next refresh. If a SAP GUI Security or information box appears, click to continue.

5. Optional: let SAP refresh on its own

This saves clicks. Right-click Handling Unit and choose Set Refresh Interval, set it to 001, then click the check. SAP refreshes the data about every minute, so you only repeat the export (Steps 3 and 4), not the whole navigation.
